prompt: Create a NEW replacement RPG inventory icon atlas using the attached game item artwork only as a visual language reference. The game is a dark fairy-tale pixel platformer in an Underworld style: deep ink silhouettes, mossy charcoal materials, restrained old brass edge highlights, warm parchment highlights; readable, charming, commercial-quality item icons. Crisp intentional pixel clusters, like hand-made 32x32 source pixel icons enlarged with nearest-neighbor, NOT painterly, NOT vector, no soft glow. Transparent background. Exactly 18 isolated complete icons in a perfectly regular SIX-COLUMN by THREE-ROW atlas, equal cells, generous transparent space between icons, no frames, no tile backgrounds, no text, no labels, no shadows outside the object. Wide landscape canvas. Each complete icon centered within its cell; each has its own strong readable silhouette, no overlap. Reading order left to right: ROW 1: [1 short brass gun barrel attachment], [2 warm red heart talisman], [3 brass ammunition magazine], [4 tightly coiled copper spring], [5 pair of moss-green jumping boots], [6 tiny brass double-bell echo charm]. ROW 2: [7 leather pistol hand-grip], [8 small rolled parchment map tied with moss-green cord], [9 amber energy vial with a brass stopper], [10 compact brass stabilizing gyroscope], [11 loop of thick braided rope], [12 short dark iron hammer with brass bands]. ROW 3: [13 metal boot brake attachment with serrated sole], [14 brass cooling-fin plate], [15 rolled cream bandage with one muted red stripe], [16 round brass coin with a bell emblem], [17 small warm red healing heart with one glint], [18 small hanging bronze bell note token]. Preserve the simple material-family consistency of the reference, but these are distinct small inventory objects, not merchant characters or scenic architecture. All 18 must be individually present, no substitutions. Use six evenly spaced column centers and three evenly spaced row centers.
